name: Modern World
description: The world of the mid-2020s with present-day borders (Natural Earth, UN boundary view). Every recognised state and Taiwan is playable; overseas dependencies belong to their sovereign states.
approximations: Population and GDP per country are rounded c. 2025 estimates; their spread across provinces, terrain, and starting armies are model estimates. No wars are active at start.

economy.note: Generated by tools/build_economy.mjs from tools/resource_table.csv. Deposits and starting industry are model estimates sized to world demand.
